policy.notes: Pre-1.9 tyre and damper dogma must never be used as the primary coaching source. Treat legacy forum pressures (≈27.5–29 psi hot) and old temp targets as obsolete unless explicitly tagged historical.

eras.label: Pre-1.9
headline_changes: Legacy tyre model and hot-pressure meta dominated community setup advice.
Kunos tyre physics rewrite — new pressure windows and heating behaviour.
Steering lock and electronics baselines updated on several GT3 cars (e.g. Ferrari 296 fix in 1.9.3).
Damper model and setup fidelity improvements; KB verified on 1.10.3.

references.note: ACC 1.9 tyre physics overhaul — dry hot target band moves to ~26–27 psi; wet ~30–31 psi.
ACC 1.10 damper behaviour and garage fidelity — 4-way click maps remain primary levers.
